# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

_Not yet known._

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)

## American {#american}

Americans are summer visitors to the shore who stay at places like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +5 more_

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives are a political affiliation supported by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), in opposition to the Liberals or [Grits](../codex/factions.md#grits).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P5](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P8](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0008), +15 more_

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a family, including siblings [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who live together at their secluded [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) homestead known as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), +5 more_

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments, such as concerts at the hall, to raise funds for the library.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P5](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P6](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P8](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0008), +16 more_

## French {#french}

The French are a group of people whose half-grown boys are sometimes hired for farm help, though they are perceived as leaving for the [States](../codex/places.md#states) or lobster canneries once trained.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P21](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P22](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0022), +14 more_

## Grits {#grits}

The Grits are a political party whose members include some of the local schoolboys as well as [Prissy](../character/prissy-andrews.md) Andrews's father.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P7](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberals are a political faction countenanced by individuals such as [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P37](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P38](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a family whose members, ending with [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md), attended the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school over a twenty-year period and were known for making life difficult for schoolteachers.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P37](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0037), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P39](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0039), +5 more_

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a local family or group whose members refused to have any dealings with the Bells following a feud over their respective roles in a school concert program.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061), [v1 CHAPTER XXV.
